title: A letter to a sick friend

writingModel:
Dear Amir,

I'm writing to say that I hope you feel better very soon. We all heard that you've got food poisoning and that you've had to stay home for a few days. I'm so sorry to hear that — it sounds absolutely terrible! Zhibek told me you were quite unwell yesterday evening.

I'm sure the doctors have given you good advice. The most important thing right now is to rest properly and drink plenty of fluids. Make sure you follow all the doctor's instructions — drink your water, avoid solid food for now, and take your medicines on time. I know you're the kind of person who wants to work even when you're ill, but please resist the temptation! Your body has to recover first.

Don't worry about university at all. I've already spoken to our group coordinator and explained the situation. Your absences will be officially excused, so you won't have to stress about that. I've also collected all the lecture notes from today and put them in our shared online folder. There's no rush — you can look at them when you're feeling better.

We really miss you in class, especially in English. It was quiet today without your tech wizard jokes! Rustam asked me to send his greetings, and Zhibek said she'll bring you some homemade soup this evening. She's an excellent cook — much better than the cafeteria, I'm sure!

Please eat well when you can, sleep as much as possible, and don't push yourself to come back too early. We want you to return fully recovered, not half-recovered. Take care of yourself, and I'll see you very soon.

Get well soon! 💚
Your friend,
Kamila
